title: Hydroxyl-modified chitosan nanofiber beads for sustainable boron removal and environmental applications
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,7090-7102
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00077G, Paper

Ho Hong Quyen, Hoang M. Nguyen, Vu Chi Mai Tran, Phuoc-Cuong Le, Masashi Kurashina, Mikito Yasuzawa, Yuki Hiraga
Eco-friendly beads from chitosan nanofibers enhance boron removal from wastewater, overcoming slow kinetics, limited capacity, and high regeneration costs, providing sustainable solutions for environmental protection and urban development.
